en: Sepia-toned historical photograph of a packed marble stadium during a formal ceremony. The stands are filled with spectators wearing late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing, while officials in dark suits line up on the track. In the infield stands a tall pillar or mast decorated with a wreath or garland. At one side there is a monumental arched entrance set into the tiers of seating. The overall look suggests an antique-style Olympic or ceremonial event.
